Name: Vanilla Bosses and Dragons
Author: SrBan2345
Description:
VANILLA BOSSES AND DRAGONS

Adds a boss fight on the floor before every treasure room in the Mines: floors 9, 19, 29... up to 119, 12 bosses in total. Each boss is a monster from its zone, but giant and much tougher. The last one is a fire-breathing dragon.

FEATURES
- 12 bosses, one for each treasure room in the Mines: slimes, a bat, a ghost, a skeleton, a shadow brute and the dragon on floor 119.
- Bosses have much more health and deal more damage. Slime bosses use different colors, and bat bosses are bigger than the rest.
- Boss floors have no random monsters and no stones, so you can focus on the fight.
- You can't go deeper until the boss is defeated. If you reach a lower floor by stairs or by elevator, you are sent back to the boss floor.
- When a boss falls, a ladder down opens where it died and ore veins sprout along the edges of the floor, as if the boss had been hiding them (copper, iron or gold, depending on the zone).
- Progress stars: hover over Mining in the skills menu to see how many bosses you have defeated.
- English and Spanish translations.


CONFIGURATION
Install Generic Mod Config Menu (optional) to change everything in game: boss health, damage and sizes, how many ore veins sprout, whether previous bosses are required, and where the stars panel is shown. Without it, you can edit config.json in the mod folder.

REQUIREMENTS
- Stardew Valley 1.6 or later
- SMAPI
- Generic Mod Config Menu (optional)

INSTALLATION
1. Install SMAPI.
2. Unzip the MinaDragon folder into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder.
3. Launch the game with SMAPI.

IMPORTANT NOTES
- This is a beta. The default difficulty is high (60x health, 3x damage). Lower it in the options if you prefer.
- If you already have a game far into the Mines, you will have to defeat the bosses starting from floor 9. To avoid this, turn off "Require previous bosses" in the options.
- If a boss ever fails to appear, turn off "Require previous bosses" so you are not stuck, and please tell me what happened.
- Multiplayer has not been tested.
- Not tested with mods that change the Mines or their monsters.
- Tested on Linux.
- Removing the mod is safe. The only thing it saves is your star progress.

THANKS
Thanks to the community for the idea of turning the mod into a boss system.

Made with AI assistance: the code, translations and this description were written with Claude (Anthropic), under my direction and testing.

ESPAÑOL

Añade un jefe en el piso anterior a cada cofre de las minas: pisos 9, 19, 29... hasta el 119 (12 jefes). Cada jefe es un monstruo de su zona, pero enorme y mucho más resistente, y el último es un dragón que escupe fuego.

- Sin monstruos aleatorios ni piedras en los pisos de jefe, y no puedes bajar sin derrotarlo.
- Al derrotarlo se abre una escalera y brotan vetas de mineral en las orillas del piso.
- Estrellas de progreso al pasar el mouse sobre Minería en el menú de habilidades.
- Se configura todo desde el juego con Generic Mod Config Menu (opcional).
- Requiere SMAPI. Instalación: descomprime la carpeta MinaDragon en tu carpeta Mods.
- Es una versión beta, con dificultad alta por defecto. El multijugador no está probado.
